credito_sugerido: Source: ANZCOR Guideline 9.4.8; Johnston et al., MJA, 2017 (ASP-20)
nota: F144 e F145 relidos. F148 é da base (leitor C): nenhuma fonte mede a parte do soro. PENDENTE f131, ACHADO, com a revista CERTA: é Welton, Liew & Braitberg, TOXICON 2017;131:11–15 (NCIS, jan/2000 a dez/2016), e não o Intern Med J (esse é Welton, Williams & Liew, sobre os artrópodes). O trecho: 'Death from snake bite remains rare in Australia, and has maintained a steady rate for over 20 years.' E: 'Thirty five deaths (2.2 per year) were ascribed or antecedent to a snake bite' (35 / 17 anos = 2.06; o '2.2' do resumo supõe 16 anos: se for à tela, '35 IN 17 YEARS', nunca '2.2 A YEAR'). Os 35 de Welton (2000–2016) NÃO são os 35 do X20 do ABS (2016–2025): coincidência de número, períodos e fontes diferentes.

texto_aprovado: The doctors who study all this are careful about it. No one has compared the bandage with other first aid in the field, and as of that national study, no controlled trial of the antivenoms had been published. Medicine is part of why so few people die of snakebite. It isn't the whole of it, and nothing we've read measures how much.
